After school, Mia wants to sing.
How is Mia in the morning?

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: Mia gets up, gets dressed and has breakfast. After school, she has a snack and draws. At night, she is tired and says good night.

items.q: What does Mia do in the morning?
items.model: She gets up, washes her face and gets dressed. Then she has breakfast.

items.q: What does Mia do when she gets home?
items.model: She has a snack, and then she draws.

items.q: How does Mia feel at night?
What do you do after school?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the events in the order of the story.
